Consensus is pricing a calm regime (VIX under 20); we read the risk as sentiment (F&G 68 to 50) catching down to a hawkish backdrop (10Y 5.13%, Brent about $110+) and a tech-led drawdown that crypto has not yet fully echoed. The disagreement is a risk-on regime against a Restrictive Macro lens.

Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.4K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play, more likely with a hawkish surprise or a VIX close above 25.
